front: What is FCM token (Firebase Cloud Messaging) in one sentence?
back: Device-scoped token identifying one app install for push delivery — rotate on reinstall, clear data, or token refresh.

front: Explain the mental model of FCM token (Firebase Cloud Messaging) (how the system thinks).
back: Client SDK asks FCM for a registration token. Your backend stores (userId, fcmToken, platform). FCM uses token + Firebase project credentials to deliver to Google/Apple push infrastructure. Tokens expire and refresh — listen for refresh callbacks and update DB.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for FCM token (Firebase Cloud Messaging)?
back: App → FCM SDK → token → your API → store → Server → FCM HTTP v1 → device

front: Given a broken FCM token (Firebase Cloud Messaging) setup, what is your first validation command?
back: App → FCM SDK → token → your API → store

front: Symptom: registration-token-not-registered — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Stale token in DB · Fix: Delete token; client re-registers

front: Symptom: Web push fails — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: VAPID key, HTTPS · Fix: Serve over HTTPS; matching VAPID in Firebase console

front: Symptom: iOS no push — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: APNs key/certs in Firebase · Fix: Upload APNs auth key; enable push capability

front: Symptom: Duplicate notifications — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Multiple tokens per user · Fix: Dedupe; send to latest token set

front: Symptom: Works on Android, not iOS — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Permission / focus mode · Fix: Request permission; check provisional auth

front: Gotcha with FCM token (Firebase Cloud Messaging): what silently fails?
back: Legacy server key API deprecated — migrate to HTTP v1 + service account. Don't use token as user id — one user, many devices; many tokens. Test tokens in logs — treat as secrets in support tickets.

front: When should you NOT use FCM token (Firebase Cloud Messaging)?
back: Don't poll FCM for inbound messages — use onMessage handlers + your API for data sync. Don't store tokens without TTL cleanup — unregistered errors will clutter sends.
